observations: Photo 0 shows the retail box for a Russell Hobbs Steam Power Steam Generator iron.
The brand 'Russell Hobbs' and model 'Steam Power' are clearly printed on the box.
The box mentions '4.5 BAR PRESSURE' and '3x MORE STEAM'.
The top of the box appears to be sealed with clear tape, suggesting it has been opened or reinforced.
The actual iron and base station are not visible; only the product photography on the box is shown.

claims.claim: The Calc-clean function removes limescale build-up
claims.evidence: This is a manufacturer-stated feature of the model; its effectiveness on this specific unit cannot be verified without testing.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, older, or damaged item.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual iron and base unit outside of the packaging.

risks.risk: The iron may have significant internal limescale blockage despite the cleaning function.
risks.proof: A video showing the iron producing a steady flow of steam without spitting water or white flakes.

risks.risk: The unit may not power on or heat up correctly.
risks.proof: A video of the unit plugged in with the power and 'ready' lights illuminated.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual iron and base unit outside of the box.
Video of the iron powered on and producing steam.
Photo of the soleplate to check for scratches or burnt-on residue.
response.reason: Only the retail packaging is shown. Without photos of the actual item, its presence, condition, and functionality cannot be confirmed.
